chapters.title: The Seaside Train
chapters.completeText: Aunt Bea is waiting on the platform with a huge hug. Tomorrow she shows us her bookshop by the harbor!

tasks.prompt: Our train to the sea leaves early, and the conductor hands each child a sticker sheet. Read what is on ours.
tasks.success: Seven stars - we stick them all along the window.

tasks.prompt: Across the aisle sits a family with a picnic bag. Read who is by their window and what is happening.
tasks.success: The baby sleeps all the way to the sea, and nobody wakes her up.

tasks.prompt: At the first stop, a poster on the platform shows the seaside zoo. Read who is on it.
tasks.success: A big turtle smiles from the poster. We will visit the zoo this week!

tasks.prompt: The boy in front of us holds up his favorite toy. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A yellow car, just like a real taxi!

tasks.prompt: Someone from our family is over by the carriage door. Read who it is and what is going on.
tasks.success: Mom stands by the door and holds the rail, so she can see the sea first.

tasks.prompt: A zookeeper climbs aboard with a cage under a cloth. Read who peeks out.
tasks.success: Four parrots peek out and whistle hello to the whole carriage!

tasks.prompt: Outside the window, green fields roll by. Read who is grazing by the fence.
tasks.success: A small horse - a pony! - looks up as we rattle past.

tasks.prompt: The girl in the next seat opens her backpack. Read what she pulls out.
tasks.success: An orange ball - she will bounce it all week long.

tasks.prompt: Somebody in the seat behind us has taken this train many times. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: Grandma sings an old song about the sea, and the whole carriage hums along.

tasks.prompt: At last the harbor shines below the tracks. Read what is out on the water.
tasks.success: Eight boats bob in the harbor - we are here!

chapters.title: Aunt Bea's Bookshop
chapters.completeText: The shop is locked for the night, and the cat is still asleep. Tomorrow we walk down to the harbor!

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea unlocks her little shop by the harbor. Read what is lying on the counter.
tasks.success: A green book with a map of the whole town inside!

tasks.prompt: The shop has a pet who never leaves the window seat. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: The shop cat sleeps in the sun. Her name is Marmalade.

tasks.prompt: Behind the counter stands a tall glass jar. Read what is in it.
tasks.success: Ten pencils, sharp and ready for drawing.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea gives each of us a bookmark. Read what is printed on mine.
tasks.success: A purple heart on my bookmark - my favorite color!

tasks.prompt: Something peeks out from behind the bottom shelf. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small mouse! Marmalade keeps dozing, so he is quite safe.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea's shop is quiet this morning. Read who from our family is busy and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom paints a new sign for the shop window, with curly letters.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea opens a picture book for us. Read who is on the first page.
tasks.success: Three monkeys grin at us from the first page.

tasks.prompt: A neighbor drops by and leaves a little present on the counter. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A white flower for Aunt Bea - she puts it in a cup of water.

tasks.prompt: On the wall hangs a poster from the aquarium on the pier. Read who is on it.
tasks.success: A big penguin - we will meet him at the aquarium soon!

tasks.prompt: At closing time, somebody sits on the step outside the shop. Read who and what is going on.
tasks.success: A girl from next door sings while Aunt Bea locks up.

chapters.title: The Harbor
chapters.completeText: Captain Gus ties up his boat for the night. Tomorrow he takes us to the aquarium at the end of the pier!

tasks.prompt: Captain Gus the seal waves to us from his boat. Read what is up on top of the mast.
tasks.success: A white flag flaps in the wind on Captain Gus's boat.

tasks.prompt: Gus shows us a bucket at the end of the pier. Read who is inside.
tasks.success: Seven crabs click their claws at the bottom of the bucket.

tasks.prompt: Something is splashing in the water by the pier. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A big octopus waves a long arm at us!

tasks.prompt: Read who from our family is on Gus's boat and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad climbs up high to get a better look at the harbor.

tasks.prompt: Every boat in the harbor has a sign on its side. Read what is painted on Gus's boat.
tasks.success: An orange diamond - Gus says every sailor knows his boat by it.

tasks.prompt: Near the beach, a little family paddles in a row. Read who they are.
tasks.success: Nine ducks paddle across the water in a neat line.

tasks.prompt: Gus points far out past the end of the pier. Read what he sees.
tasks.success: A small boat - Gus's cousin is rowing back from fishing.

tasks.prompt: Gus says that someone lives far out past the harbor. Read who and what is happening.
tasks.success: A whale sings far out at sea, and Gus can hear it from his deck.

tasks.prompt: A stall by the pier sells food for boat trips. Read what Gus buys.
tasks.success: A red pepper for Gus's famous fish soup. Hot, hot, hot!

tasks.prompt: Before we go, Gus empties his coat pockets onto the table. Read what he gives us.
tasks.success: Eight shells for our collection, smooth and shiny.

chapters.title: The Aquarium
chapters.completeText: We wave goodbye to the fish. Tomorrow Miss Iris gives a painting class right on the beach!

tasks.prompt: Behind the first glass wall, someone swims very fast. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A big dolphin zooms past and leaps out of the water!

tasks.prompt: The next tank glows blue and green. Read who lives in it.
tasks.success: Eight fish swim round and round in a shiny swirl.

tasks.prompt: Gus leads us to a room with rocks and a little pool. Read who is there and what is happening.
tasks.success: A penguin sleeps standing up on a rock. How does he do that?

tasks.prompt: Each tank has a button that lights up. Read what the button looks like.
tasks.success: A blue square button - press it, and the tank lights come on!

tasks.prompt: Down a ramp there is a sandy pool. Read who is there.
tasks.success: Three turtles crawl slowly across the warm sand.

tasks.prompt: Gus kneels by a rock pool. Read what is hiding there.
tasks.success: A small crab scuttles under a rock.

tasks.prompt: Someone from our family is next to the huge glass wall. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad stands so close to the glass that a fish swims right up to his nose!

tasks.prompt: At the gift shop, each child can pick one badge. Read which badge is mine.
tasks.success: A pink heart badge for my jacket!

tasks.prompt: In the movie room, the screen shows the open sea. Read who swims across it.
tasks.success: Six whales swim across the screen, slow and huge.

tasks.prompt: On the bench by the exit, a family takes a rest. Read who and what is happening.
tasks.success: The baby sings a happy la-la-la, and the fish seem to listen.

chapters.title: The Painting Class
chapters.completeText: Our paintings are drying in the sun. Tomorrow Captain Gus takes us up the old lighthouse!

tasks.prompt: Miss Iris gives each of us a brush and a sheet of paper. Read what she paints first.
tasks.success: A yellow dot - that is the sun, says Miss Iris.

tasks.prompt: Next, Miss Iris paints in the corner of the paper. Read what appears there.
tasks.success: A green square - that is the garden.

tasks.prompt: Someone from our family comes over to see the class. Read who it is and what they do.
tasks.success: Mom paints the sea with long, wavy strokes.

tasks.prompt: Miss Iris opens her wooden box. Read what is inside.
tasks.success: Four brushes, from very thin to very fat.

tasks.prompt: A guest wanders onto the beach and sits right on Miss Iris's paper. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small chick! Now there are tiny footprints all over the painting.

tasks.prompt: We each make a card for Aunt Bea. Read what is on mine.
tasks.success: An orange heart for Aunt Bea - she will love it.

tasks.prompt: Break time! Miss Iris opens a tin. Read what she shares.
tasks.success: Nine cookies, one for everyone in the class.

tasks.prompt: Somebody comes to watch from the palm tree. Read who is up there.
tasks.success: A big parrot - he wants to be in the painting too!

tasks.prompt: Under the class umbrella, a furry guest has found some shade. Read who and what is going on.
tasks.success: A dog sleeps in the shade until the class is over.

tasks.prompt: At the end, everyone shows their picture, and somebody is very proud. Read who that is and what happens next.
tasks.success: Dad dances a happy little dance next to his painting.

chapters.title: The Lighthouse
chapters.completeText: The lighthouse lamp sweeps over the dark sea. Tomorrow we visit the little seaside zoo!

tasks.prompt: The old lighthouse has an iron ladder on the inside. Read who is at the bottom of it and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom climbs up and up, all the way to the top.

tasks.prompt: In the keeper's old room, Gus opens a dusty cupboard. Read what he takes out.
tasks.success: A big candle - the old keepers read by its light.

tasks.prompt: From the top we can see the whole sky. Read what floats over the sea.
tasks.success: Five clouds drift over the sea, fluffy and white.

tasks.prompt: Out on the balcony, somebody is sitting on the railing next to us. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A black bird - Gus says she comes up every morning for crumbs.

tasks.prompt: Far below, Gus points to the place where he lives. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A small house right by the water - that is Gus's home.

tasks.prompt: In the keeper's armchair sits an old friend of Gus. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: Grandpa sleeps in the armchair - the ladder was a lot of work!

tasks.prompt: On the window ledge, Gus keeps a few things from the old days. Read what is there.
tasks.success: Four candles, ready for stormy nights.

tasks.prompt: Gus keeps a little pot by the lighthouse door. Read what grows in it.
tasks.success: A yellow flower that always turns to face the sun.

tasks.prompt: Through the telescope we spot something far out at sea. Read what is out there.
tasks.success: A small whale - just a baby, Gus says - rolls through the waves.

tasks.prompt: When we come back down, it is already dark. Read what we see over the lighthouse.
tasks.success: Nine stars twinkle over the lighthouse, and the lamp begins to turn.

chapters.title: The Seaside Zoo
chapters.completeText: Keeper Lou waves from the gate. Tomorrow it is going to rain, so Aunt Bea has a plan!

tasks.prompt: Keeper Lou opens the gate to the first pen. Read who lives there.
tasks.success: A big giraffe bends down to say hello.

tasks.prompt: Next to it is a wide sandy yard. Read who is standing in it.
tasks.success: Three camels chew slowly and look at us with sleepy eyes.

tasks.prompt: In the tree house, somebody sits on a high branch. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: A monkey sleeps on the branch, snoring very softly.

tasks.prompt: Keeper Lou shows us a cave with a pool in front of it. Read what we spot there.
tasks.success: A brown bear splashes in the pool to cool off.

tasks.prompt: Keeper Lou stops by a wide fence. Read who is behind it.
tasks.success: Two hippos wallow in the mud and blow bubbles.

tasks.prompt: In a far corner of the zoo, someone is holding on to a tree. Read who and what is going on.
tasks.success: A koala sleeps in the fork of the tree - almost all day, Keeper Lou says.

tasks.prompt: Behind the thick glass, someone plays with a rope. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small tiger cub pounces on the rope!

tasks.prompt: Keeper Lou lets us give the giraffe a snack. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A green apple - the giraffe crunches it in one bite.

tasks.prompt: In a tall round cage, everyone is chattering at once. Read who is inside.
tasks.success: Ten parrots - and every one of them says hello!

tasks.prompt: At the zoo cafe, someone from our family is showing off for Keeper Lou. Read who it is and what they do.
tasks.success: Dad juggles, and Keeper Lou claps along.

chapters.title: The Toy Shop
chapters.completeText: The rain is still drumming on the roof. Tonight we play games at Aunt Bea's kitchen table!

tasks.prompt: It is raining, so Aunt Bea takes us to the toy shop on the corner. Read what is in the window.
tasks.success: A small drum, just right for little hands. Boom, boom, boom!

tasks.prompt: Upstairs is the music corner. Read what hangs on the wall.
tasks.success: Six guitars hang in a row, waiting for someone to play.

tasks.prompt: In a basket by the door there is one thing left for us to buy. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A white ball for games on the beach - once the rain stops.

tasks.prompt: On the soft toy shelf, Aunt Bea picks one out for us. Read which toy she chooses.
tasks.success: A small monkey with a silly grin.

tasks.prompt: Someone from our family tries out a toy from the shop. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom juggles the bean bags, and the shop owner laughs.

tasks.prompt: On the counter is a box of shiny stickers. Read which one we choose.
tasks.success: A blue diamond sticker - it sparkles like real treasure!

tasks.prompt: Up near the ceiling, toys hang on strings. Read what they are.
tasks.success: Seven kites, ready for a windy day.

tasks.prompt: The shop owner has a pet who lives by the till. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: The parrot sings every time the door bell rings!

tasks.prompt: We spot one more soft toy on the top shelf. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small panda for Marmalade the shop cat to cuddle.

tasks.prompt: In the reading nook at the back of the shop, a child is lying on a beanbag. Read who and what is going on.
tasks.success: A boy sleeps on the beanbag - the rain makes everyone sleepy.

chapters.title: Games at the Kitchen Table
chapters.completeText: The storm is over and the stars are back. Tomorrow is the flower show in the town square!

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea brings out an old game board. Read what is on the first space.
tasks.success: A red square - that is where we start!

tasks.prompt: The storm rattles the windows, and Aunt Bea brings something to the table. Read what it is.
tasks.success: Five candles light up the kitchen, warm and cozy.

tasks.prompt: Under the kitchen dresser there is a tiny house made from a matchbox. Read who is in it and what is happening.
tasks.success: A mouse sleeps in the matchbox bed, under a sock for a blanket.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea moves her game piece. Read where it lands.
tasks.success: A black square - oh no, Aunt Bea has to go back three spaces!

tasks.prompt: For a snack, Aunt Bea opens the bread bin. Read what she finds.
tasks.success: A big cupcake to share between all of us.

tasks.prompt: Someone from our family is at the end of the table. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad paints a picture of the storm, with lots and lots of gray.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea deals out picture cards. Read who is on my card.
tasks.success: Three pandas - the luckiest card in the whole game!

tasks.prompt: At the window, someone is making its way up the wet glass. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small snail leaves a shiny trail on the glass.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea reaches into the fruit bowl for the grown-ups. Read what she takes out.
tasks.success: Four lemons for hot lemon tea.

tasks.prompt: The neighbor from next door has come over for tea. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: Grandma Moss sleeps in the armchair while the storm rumbles on.

chapters.title: The Flower Show
chapters.completeText: Aunt Bea's rose stands in a jar on the counter. Tomorrow the circus comes to town!

tasks.prompt: The town square is full of stalls. Read what the first one sells.
tasks.success: A pink flower, soft as a cloud.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Ned has a stall in the corner. Read what is in his bucket.
tasks.success: Six tulips with long green stems.

tasks.prompt: A gardener has won first prize. Read what she grew.
tasks.success: A purple flower that smells like summer.

tasks.prompt: Someone crawls out from under a leaf on the prize table. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A big beetle! The judges jump back.

tasks.prompt: A band starts to play by the fountain. Read who from our family is there and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom dances to the band right by the fountain.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea buys one thing to take home for her shop counter. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A red flower - a rose, with a lovely smell!

tasks.prompt: Around the honey stall there are tiny visitors everywhere. Read who they are.
tasks.success: Seven bees buzz around the honey jars.

tasks.prompt: A girl brings her own pot to the children's table. Read what is in it.
tasks.success: A small tulip - and it wins a ribbon for the youngest grower!

tasks.prompt: Under a shady tree, a family has spread out a blanket. Read who and what is happening.
tasks.success: The baby sleeps under the tree, with petals falling all around.

tasks.prompt: At the last stall, Farmer Ned has something for Aunt Bea's kitchen. Read what he hands over.
tasks.success: Four carrots, fresh from Farmer Ned's garden.

chapters.title: The Circus Comes to Town
chapters.completeText: The circus lights go out one by one. Tomorrow we have a picnic on the beach!

tasks.prompt: A striped tent goes up on the beach. Read what is printed on our tickets.
tasks.success: A purple square on each ticket - that is our row!

tasks.prompt: Lulu the clown comes out with a helper on her shoulder. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A big monkey rides on Lulu's shoulder and waves to everyone.

tasks.prompt: Lulu asks for a helper from the crowd. Read who from our family goes into the ring and what they do.
tasks.success: Mom stands very still while Lulu balances a cup on her head!

tasks.prompt: The drums roll, and the next act comes in. Read who walks into the ring.
tasks.success: A small camel trots round the ring, and everyone cheers.

tasks.prompt: A second clown tosses things high into the air. Read what goes up.
tasks.success: Seven balls whirl through the air, and not one falls!

tasks.prompt: Behind the curtain, a performer waits for its turn. Read who and what is going on.
tasks.success: A lion sleeps behind the curtain until it is time for the show.

tasks.prompt: At the break, Lulu paints a picture on each child's cheek. Read what is on mine.
tasks.success: A yellow heart on my cheek - it tickles!

tasks.prompt: Next comes a guest who struts in very proudly. Read who that is.
tasks.success: A big rooster - cock-a-doodle-doo!

tasks.prompt: In the next act, the ring fills up. Read who jumps through the hoops.
tasks.success: Three tigers leap through the hoops, one after another.

tasks.prompt: At the very end, someone is sitting in the front row. Read who it is and what happens.
tasks.success: A girl in the front row sings the circus song, and the band plays along.

chapters.title: The Beach Picnic
chapters.completeText: Our towels are full of sand and our tummies are full of lunch. Tomorrow we visit Farmer Ned up on the hill!

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea opens the picnic basket. Read what is on top.
tasks.success: A yellow ball - first a game, then lunch!

tasks.prompt: Something crawls out of the sea onto the sand. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small turtle looks around, then heads slowly back to the waves.

tasks.prompt: We dig a moat around our sandcastle. Read what we find.
tasks.success: Six shells for the top of our sandcastle.

tasks.prompt: Under the umbrella, someone from our family is on the towel. Read who and what is happening.
tasks.success: Dad sleeps under the umbrella while the waves go hush, hush.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea passes round lunch. Read what I get.
tasks.success: A big banana - perfect after a swim.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea's beach towel has a pattern in the middle. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A white heart in the middle of Aunt Bea's towel.

tasks.prompt: In a rock pool, somebody is tucked under the weed. Read who is hiding there.
tasks.success: A small octopus peeks out, then squirts away.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea lifts the lid of the cool box. Read what is inside.
tasks.success: Nine pears, cold and juicy.

tasks.prompt: In the sand dunes by the path, someone sits on a log. Read who and what is going on.
tasks.success: A frog sings ribbit-ribbit from the dunes.

tasks.prompt: Before we pack up, someone from our family jumps up from the towel. Read who it is and what they do.
tasks.success: Mom dances in the sand, and we all join in!

chapters.title: Farmer Ned's Hill
chapters.completeText: Farmer Ned waves as we walk back down the hill. Tomorrow Baker Sam lets us help in the bakery!

tasks.prompt: Farmer Ned opens the gate, and someone runs up to meet us. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small rooster with a very loud voice!

tasks.prompt: On the green slope, a flock is grazing. Read who they are.
tasks.success: Seven sheep, white and woolly, munch the grass.

tasks.prompt: In the barn, someone is lying in the straw. Read who and what is happening.
tasks.success: A cow sleeps in the warm straw.

tasks.prompt: In the vegetable patch, Farmer Ned pulls something up. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big carrot - Farmer Ned needs both hands to hold it!

tasks.prompt: Along the farmyard wall, all the top doors are open. Read who looks out.
tasks.success: Five horses look out and nod hello.

tasks.prompt: Farmer Ned reaches into his garden for us. Read what he picks.
tasks.success: A green pepper, crisp and shiny.

tasks.prompt: Someone trots after Farmer Ned wherever he goes. Read who his new friend is.
tasks.success: A small sheep - a lamb - follows Farmer Ned like a puppy.

tasks.prompt: Someone has flown over to the farm. Read who has come.
tasks.success: A white bird - a dove - coos on the barn roof.

tasks.prompt: Read who from our family is by the haystack and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad climbs right up the haystack and waves from the top!

tasks.prompt: In the pen by the barn, somebody lies in the sun. Read who and what is going on.
tasks.success: A pig sleeps in the sun and snores like a tractor.

chapters.title: The Bakery
chapters.completeText: Our bags smell of warm bread. Tomorrow is the kite festival on the cliffs!

tasks.prompt: Baker Sam takes a tray out of the oven. Read what is on it.
tasks.success: A big cookie, as wide as a plate!

tasks.prompt: On the shelf by the window, Sam shows us today's orders. Read what is there.
tasks.success: Five cakes for a birthday party in town.

tasks.prompt: Someone from our family helps out in the shop. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Dad stands at the counter and hands out the bread.

tasks.prompt: Sam lets each of us make a treat of our own. Read what I make.
tasks.success: A small cupcake, just right for one bite.

tasks.prompt: Sam draws on a cake with icing. Read what he draws.
tasks.success: A brown heart in chocolate icing - yum!

tasks.prompt: Sam packs a paper bag for Aunt Bea. Read what goes in.
tasks.success: Six cookies for Aunt Bea's afternoon tea.

tasks.prompt: By the warm oven there is a little basket. Read who is in it and what is happening.
tasks.success: The bakery cat sleeps by the oven, warm and cozy.

tasks.prompt: Sam reaches into the fruit basket. Read what he takes.
tasks.success: A small banana, sweet and ripe.

tasks.prompt: Sam takes something down from the high shelf. Read what it is.
tasks.success: An orange book full of his grandma's recipes.

tasks.prompt: At the corner table sits a regular customer with a pot of tea. Read who and what is going on.
tasks.success: Grandpa Joe sings a song about fresh bread every morning!

chapters.title: The Kite Festival
chapters.completeText: Our kite is rolled up and tucked under Aunt Bea's arm. Tomorrow is the big town dance!

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea unrolls our new kite on the grass. Read what is printed on it.
tasks.success: An orange diamond - our kite will be easy to spot in the sky!

tasks.prompt: Up in the sky, something is bobbing in the wind. Read what we spot.
tasks.success: A small kite loops and dips in the wind.

tasks.prompt: From the top of the cliff we can see the whole sky. Read what is up there.
tasks.success: Nine kites tug at their strings.

tasks.prompt: At the top of the cliff, a child is on a picnic blanket. Read who and what is happening.
tasks.success: A girl sleeps on the blanket, worn out from running with her kite.

tasks.prompt: Somebody perches on the fence by the cliff path. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small parrot - it must have flown over from the zoo!

tasks.prompt: Something lands right on Aunt Bea's hat. Read what has landed.
tasks.success: A green leaf, blown all the way up from the woods.

tasks.prompt: A man at the festival stall hands us something on a string. Read what we get.
tasks.success: A big balloon, tied to my wrist so it can't fly away.

tasks.prompt: Far out to sea, below the cliffs, something is moving. Read what we see.
tasks.success: Three whales swim past the cliffs - what a lucky day!

tasks.prompt: At the food stall, the lady shows us what she is about to slice. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A small lemon, but it is very sour!

tasks.prompt: The festival ends with music on the cliff top. Read who from our family is out there and what they do.
tasks.success: Dad dances on the cliff top, and everyone claps along!

chapters.title: The Town Dance
chapters.completeText: Our feet are tired from dancing. Tonight Aunt Bea takes us up the hill to look at the stars!

tasks.prompt: The floor of the town hall is painted like a giant game board. Read where we stand.
tasks.success: An orange square - this is where we start the dance.

tasks.prompt: Between the songs, someone from our family entertains the crowd. Read who it is and what they do.
tasks.success: Mom juggles, and everyone counts the throws.

tasks.prompt: Each dancer gets a paper badge at the door. Read what is on mine.
tasks.success: A green heart badge, pinned right on my shirt.

tasks.prompt: The band sets up on the stage. Read what they bring.
tasks.success: Two guitars start to strum, and the dance begins.

tasks.prompt: Someone in a funny costume shuffles into the hall. Read who they are dressed as.
tasks.success: A small penguin! It is the girl from next door to the bookshop.

tasks.prompt: The lights go down, and a sign is lifted up over the stage. Read what is on it.
tasks.success: A black heart on the sign - it is time for the slow dance.

tasks.prompt: On each table there is something for the dancers. Read what is on ours.
tasks.success: Eight candles flicker on our table.

tasks.prompt: Keeper Lou brings a guest from the zoo to the dance. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small giraffe - Keeper Lou says she loves music.

tasks.prompt: Up in the rafters of the old hall, someone has made a home. Read who and what is going on.
tasks.success: An owl sleeps in the rafters, and the music does not wake her.

tasks.prompt: At the end of the night, Aunt Bea gets her hand stamped. Read what the stamp shows.
tasks.success: A purple dot on her hand - it means she danced all night!

chapters.title: The Night Sky
chapters.completeText: The sky watches over the sleepy town. Tomorrow is the big concert on the pier!

tasks.prompt: On top of the hill, Aunt Bea spreads out a rug, and we lie back. Read what is above us.
tasks.success: Eight stars, and more come out every minute.

tasks.prompt: Read who is behind a bush at the edge of the hill and what is happening.
tasks.success: A fox sleeps behind the bush, very still and quiet.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea points at something that shines in the dark. Read what she shows us.
tasks.success: A yellow square - that is the light in Aunt Bea's shop window!

tasks.prompt: Down in the dark harbor, something splashes under the moon. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small dolphin jumps, and the water sparkles in the moonlight.

tasks.prompt: Somebody from our family is very quiet on the rug. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom sleeps on the rug, and Aunt Bea tucks a blanket around her.

tasks.prompt: In the old oak tree, eyes shine in the dark. Read who they belong to.
tasks.success: Three owls hoot softly from the oak.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea takes one more thing out of her bag. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A small candle in a jar, to light our way home.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea shows us a star map. One planet has a mark next to it. Read what mark it has.
tasks.success: An orange dot - that is Mars, Aunt Bea says.

tasks.prompt: Back at Aunt Bea's, a box sits by the warm stove. Read who is in it and what is happening.
tasks.success: A chick sleeps in the box - Farmer Ned asked us to look after it.

tasks.prompt: On my windowsill I lay out everything I collected this week. Read what is there.
tasks.success: Nine shells in a neat row on my windowsill.

chapters.title: The Concert on the Pier
chapters.completeText: The pier is quiet again. Tomorrow is our last day in the seaside town.

tasks.prompt: Captain Gus gives us a song sheet. Read what is drawn at the top.
tasks.success: A blue heart - the sign of the Seaside Singers.

tasks.prompt: The band carries their things onto the pier. Read what they bring.
tasks.success: Seven drums - this is going to be loud!

tasks.prompt: Backstage, there is a special guest. Read who it is and what is happening.
tasks.success: A penguin sings, and everyone claps their flippers - I mean, hands!

tasks.prompt: Captain Gus brings out his own instrument. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A big guitar, almost as tall as Gus.

tasks.prompt: At the end of the pier there is a pole with something at the top. Read what is up there.
tasks.success: A black flag - Gus says it is for the pirate song!

tasks.prompt: During the break, someone from our family gets up on the stage. Read who it is and what they do.
tasks.success: Dad juggles, and the crowd counts along - one, two, three!

tasks.prompt: Something peeks up from the water under the pier. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A big octopus waves along to the music with all its arms!

tasks.prompt: After the concert, the town has something for the band. Read what they get.
tasks.success: Five gifts, one for each player in the band.

tasks.prompt: In the front row sits a neighbor of Aunt Bea's. Read who and what is going on.
tasks.success: Grandma Moss sings along to the sea song, and the whole pier joins in.

tasks.prompt: Somebody hands Grandma Moss a present for her song. Read what she gets.
tasks.success: A white flower for Grandma Moss, to wear in her hair.

chapters.title: Packing Up
chapters.completeText: Our bags are packed and waiting by the door. Tomorrow we say goodbye to the seaside town.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea brings out our suitcase. Read what is stitched on the tag.
tasks.success: A brown square - so we can tell our suitcase from all the others.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea wraps something from her garden in paper for us. Read what it is.
tasks.success: Seven tulips to take home on the train.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea hides a surprise in my bag. Read who it is.
tasks.success: A small koala toy, to hug on the train.

tasks.prompt: Read who from our family is by the tall wardrobe and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom climbs up to get the last bag down from the top.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea gives us one more present. Read what she gives us.
tasks.success: A green book of sea stories, for bedtime at home.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea's gift for the train comes in a paper box. Read what is inside.
tasks.success: A big pencil, as long as my arm!

tasks.prompt: At the house next door, the family is packing too. Read who is in the hallway and what is happening.
tasks.success: The baby sings to the suitcases - la-la-la!

tasks.prompt: Gus drops by with a farewell drawing. Read who is on it.
tasks.success: Four turtles swimming in a row - Gus drew them himself.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea folds the kitchen tablecloth. Read what is printed in the corner.
tasks.success: A white square, neat and clean, in the corner.

tasks.prompt: On the doorstep, the neighbor's pet lies on the mat. Read who and what is going on.
tasks.success: The dog next door sleeps on the mat - he will miss us.

chapters.title: Goodbye, Seaside Town
chapters.completeText: We are home, and the seaside town is in our hearts. Thank you, Aunt Bea - see you next summer!

tasks.prompt: Before we climb aboard, we look at the harbor one last time. Read what we see.
tasks.success: A small boat - Gus's cousin rows out to wave goodbye!

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea runs along the platform with something we forgot. Read what it is.
tasks.success: A brown ball! Aunt Bea found it under the sofa.

tasks.prompt: Keeper Lou has come to the station with friends from the zoo. Read who they are.
tasks.success: Five parrots squawk goodbye from Keeper Lou's arms.

tasks.prompt: Someone from our family is at the train door. Read who it is and what they are doing.
tasks.success: Mom stands at the door and waves to Aunt Bea on the platform.

tasks.prompt: Gus gives us a present for the trip home. Read who is on the wrapping paper.
tasks.success: A big turtle on the wrapping paper - Gus's favorite animal.

tasks.prompt: Aunt Bea's last hug comes with a sticker for each of us. Read which one I get.
tasks.success: A pink heart sticker - I put it right on my bag.

tasks.prompt: As the train pulls out, we look up at the cliffs. Read what is flying over them.
tasks.success: Eight kites - the festival friends are waving us off!

tasks.prompt: On the zoo field next to the tracks, someone looks up at the train. Read who is there.
tasks.success: A small hippo watches the train go by.

tasks.prompt: Halfway home, read who is in the seat across from us and what is happening.
tasks.success: A boy sleeps with his head on his backpack, dreaming of the sea.

tasks.prompt: When we get home, a postcard from Aunt Bea is waiting. Read what is drawn on it.
tasks.success: A red flower - and the words: come back next summer!
